# Giant Ancestry: Cloud's Jaunt (`traits:giant-ancestry-clouds-jaunt`)
**Species:** [Goliath](../species/goliath.md) | **Subspecies:** [Giant Ancestry: Cloud's Jaunt](../subspecies/giant-ancestry-clouds-jaunt.md)

As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
